62328-the-dream-coach.title: The Dream Coach
62328-the-dream-coach.creator: Unknown
62328-the-dream-coach.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. As the wheels turn, they wake to lovely sound,  Musical boxes—as the wheels go round  They play a little silver spray of notes:  “Swift Runs the River”—“Bluebells in the Wood”——  “The Waterfall”—“The Child Who Has Been Good”——  Like splash of foam at keel of little boats.

7212-memories-of-canada-and-scotland-spe.title: Memories Of Canada And Scotland Speeches And Verses
7212-memories-of-canada-and-scotland-spe.creator: Unknown
7212-memories-of-canada-and-scotland-spe.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. "Are hearts here strong enough to found   A glorious people's sway?" Ask of our rivers as they bound From hill to plain, or ocean-sound,   If they are strong to-day? If weakness in their floods be found,   Then may ye answer "Nay!"

8735-the-revolutions-of-time.creator: Jonathan Dunn
8735-the-revolutions-of-time.description: A book by Jonathan Dunn. Most probably it sounds foreign and unfamiliar to you, devoid of the qualities of affection and personality which give character to a name. It is a harsh name, cold and inhuman, like something out of the night, an unwelcome intruder into the warmth of familiarity.

arxiv-2108-09446.title: Reservoir computing with diverse timescales for prediction of multiscale dynamics
arxiv-2108-09446.creator: Gouhei Tanaka 1,2,3,∗, Tadayoshi Matsumori 4, Hiroaki Yoshida 4, Kazuyuki Aihara 1
arxiv-2108-09446.description: Abstract Machine learning approaches have recently been leveraged as a substitute or an aid for physical/mathematical modeling approaches to dynamical systems. To develop an efficient machine learning method dedicated to modeling and prediction of multiscale dynamics, we propose a reservoir computing (RC) model with diverse timescales by using a recurrent network of heterogeneous leaky integrator (LI) neurons.

arxiv-2204-04420.title: Investigating Deep Learning Benchmarks for Electrocardiography Signal Processing
arxiv-2204-04420.creator: Hao Wen 1 1 , Jingsu Kang 2 2
arxiv-2204-04420.description: Abstract In recent years, deep learning has witnessed its blossom in the field of Electrocardiography (ECG) processing, outperforming traditional signal processing methods in various tasks, for example, classification, QRS detection, wave delineation. Although many neural architectures have been proposed in the literature, there is a lack of systematic studies and open-source libraries for ECG deep learning.

arxiv-2209-08982.title: How to Adapt Pre-trained Vision-and-Language Models to a Text-only Input?
arxiv-2209-08982.creator: Lovisa Hagström Richard Johansson
arxiv-2209-08982.description: Abstract Current language models have been criticised for learning language from text alone without connection between words and their meaning. Consequently, multimodal training has been proposed as a way for creating models with better language understanding by providing the lacking connection.

arxiv-2309-06088.title: Kahane’s upper density and syndetic sets in LCA groups
arxiv-2309-06088.creator: Szilárd Gy. Révész
arxiv-2309-06088.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Szilárd Gy. Révész. Asymptotic uniform upper density, shortened as a.u.u.d., or simply upper density, is a classical notion which was first introduced by Kahane for sequences in the real line. Syndetic sets were defined by Gottschalk and Hendlund. For a locally compact group G G , a set S ⊂ G S\subset G is syndetic, if there exists a compact subset C ⋐ G C\Subset G such that S ​ C = G SC=G .

arxiv-2311-06506.title: From Toda hierarchy to KP hierarchy
arxiv-2311-06506.creator: Di Yang, Jian Zhou
arxiv-2311-06506.description: Abstract . Using the matrix-resolvent method and a formula of the second-named author on the n n -point function for a KP tau-function, we show that the tau-function of an arbitrary solution to the Toda lattice hierarchy is a KP tau-function.

arxiv-2312-12935.title: A comparative study of analytical models of diffuse reflectance in homogeneous biological tissues: Gelatin based phantoms and Monte Carlo experiments. Publication type: article
arxiv-2312-12935.creator: Anisha Bahl*, Silvere Segaud, Yijing Xie, Jonathan Shapey, Mads Bergholt, Tom Vercauteren
arxiv-2312-12935.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Anisha Bahl*, Silvere Segaud, Yijing Xie, Jonathan Shapey, Mads Bergholt, Tom Vercauteren. Information about tissue oxygen saturation ( S ​ t ​ O 2 StO_{2} ) and other related important physiological parameters can be extracted from diffuse reflectance spectra measured through non-contact imaging. Three analytical optical reflectance models for homogeneous, semi-infinite, tissue have been proposed (Modified Beer-Lambert, Jacques 1999, Yudovsky 2009) but these have not been directly compared for tissue parameter extraction purposes.

arxiv-2501-09308.title: Rapid, Comprehensive Search of Crystalline Phases from X-ray Diffraction in Seconds via GPU-Accelerated Bayesian Variational Inference
arxiv-2501-09308.creator: Ryo Murakami *a , Kenji Nagata b , Yoshitaka Matsushita a , Masahiko Demura a
arxiv-2501-09308.description: Abstract In analysis of X-ray diffraction data, identifying the crystalline phase is important for interpreting the material. The typical method is identifying the crystalline phase from the coincidence of the main diffraction peaks. This method identifies crystalline phases by matching them as individual crystalline phases rather than as combinations of crystalline phases, in the same way as the greedy method.

arxiv-2601-00876.title: The Maximum of the Volume of a Part of a Cevian Simplex
arxiv-2601-00876.creator: Zamina Guliyeva, Yagub Aliyev
arxiv-2601-00876.description: Abstract The cevians passing through a point in a simplex create a cevian simplex, which is divided by these cevians into smaller simplices. We consider the problem about the maximum of the ratio of the sum of the volumes of some of these smaller simplices by the volume of the reference simplex.

pmc-11340633.creator: Jingwen Li, Qingmin Li, Wei Ma, Yongsheng Zhang, Xiaonan Li
pmc-11340633.description: PurposeThe aim of this study was to explore whether MAF bZIP transcription factor B (MAFB) might alleviate ulcerative colitis (UC) in dextran sulfate sodium (DSS)‐induced mice and LPS‐induced IEC‐6 cells.MethodsUC in vivo and in vitro model was established by using DSS and LPS, respectively.

pmc-11678237.title: 5-Substituted Flavones—Another Class of Potent Triplex DNA-Specific Ligands as Antigene Enhancers
pmc-11678237.creator: Landy Gu, Nghia Tran, Vanessa M Rangel, Mandeep Singh, Krege M Christison, Geoff P Lin-Cereghino, Liang Xue, Ramon Eritja
pmc-11678237.description: In the field of drug development, the quest for novel compounds that bind to DNA with high affinity and specificity never ends. In the present work, we report the newest development in this field, namely, triplex DNA-specific binding ligands based on the 5-substituted flavone scaffold in our lab.

pmc-11728280.title: Recent Advancements in Imaging Techniques for Individual Extracellular Vesicles
pmc-11728280.creator: Tatsuki Isogai, Koichiro M. Hirosawa, Kenichi G. N. Suzuki
pmc-11728280.description: Extracellular vesicles (EVs), secreted from most cells, are small lipid membranes of vesicles of 30 to 1000 nm in diameter and contain nucleic acids, proteins, and intracellular organelles originating from donor cells. EVs play pivotal roles in intercellular communication, particularly in forming niches for cancer cell metastasis.

pmc-12734721.title: XLPE and Beyond: A Review of Recent Progress in Polymer Nanocomposites for Dielectric Insulation in High-Voltage Cables
pmc-12734721.creator: Alexander A Yurov, Ivan N Zubkov, Alexey V Lukonin, Oleg Y Kaun, Alexander E Bogachev, Victor A Klushin, Dong-Joo Kim, Mario Culebras
pmc-12734721.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Crosslinked polyethylene (XLPE) has been the cornerstone material in the power industry for insulating high-voltage cables due to its exceptional properties, including reduced dielectric loss, high dielectric constant and thermal conductivity, and excellent resistance to electrical stress. In the current study, in order to further enhance the electrical and mechanical properties of XLPE’s various types of nanofillers such as metal oxides, boron nitride nanosheets of nanosilica and graphene oxide are incorporated into the XLPE matrix.

pmc-13388820.title: Global information-seeking behavior of air pollution and cardiovascular disease: insights from google trends analysis
pmc-13388820.creator: Javeria Akhter, Talha Ali, Aasiya Shahbaz, Noor Ul Ain Shahzad, Jamil Nasrallah
pmc-13388820.description: IntroductionAir pollution (AP) contributes to over 4.2 million premature deaths annually, with approximately 20% linked to cardiovascular disease (CVD)-related deaths. Despite robust scientific evidence, information-seeking behavior remains poorly characterized. This study applies an infodemiological approach to assess global information-seeking behavior related to AP and its cardiovascular implications.
